init_ref_tools.ori_description: devsim.create_gmsh_mesh (mesh, file, coordinates, elements, physical_names)  Create a mesh to import a Gmsh mesh  Parameters ---------- mesh : str name of the mesh being generated file : str, optional name of the Gmsh mesh file being read into DEVSIM coordinates : list, optional List of coordinate positions on mesh. elements : list, optional List of elements on the mesh. physical_names : list, optional List of names for each contact, interface, and region on mesh.  Notes -----  This file will import a Gmsh format mesh from a file. Alternatively, the mesh structure may be passed in as as arguments:  ``coordinates`` is a float list of positions in the mesh. Each coordinate adds an x, y, and z position so that the coordinate list length is 3 times the number of coordinates.  ``physical_names`` is a list of contact, interface, and region names. It is referenced by index by the ``elements`` list.  ``elements`` is a list of elements. Each element adds  * Element Type (float)  - 0 node - 1 edge - 2 triangle - 3 tetrahedron  * Physical Index  - This indexes into the ``physical_names`` list.  * Nodes  - Each node of the element indexes into the coordinates list.

basic_info.name: devsim
basic_info.description: DEVSIM 是采用有限体积法的开源半导体器件仿真软件，通过 Python 接口定义网格、材料参数、物理模型和方程，支持一维、二维和三维器件的直流、交流及瞬态计算，并提供电路耦合、符号微分和仿真结果读写功能。

capabilities.description: 让独立任务清空并检查命名器件/区域/接触的生命周期。
覆盖本地1D PN及2D Si/oxide结构创建、接触/界面映射；Gmsh只读取固定网格文件，不添加第二个求解器。
建立可变的材料、掺杂相关模型参数和接触偏压并可查询核查。
定义和检查掺杂、电势、场、载流子与边界模型；支持从平衡解设置初值及局部修复。保留原生定义器，排除只有打印差异的同名高层薄包装。
创建并审计Poisson/连续性/接触/界面方程；必要时替换错误方程，而非仅能执行封闭黑盒。
DC求解、导出实际矩阵与RHS用于独立诊断、读取接触电流/电荷进行守恒和目标断言。
在独立输出目录保存与恢复DEVSIM原生状态；tecplot等展示输出与可重载格式分别处理。
保留有实质组合价值的解变量/边端映射及自动导数辅助；这些是simple_physics内的必要模式，避免任务重复手工展开。
构造Si/oxide Poisson、SRH漂移扩散、欧姆接触与界面，先平衡再载流子连续性，补齐原选集缺少的主链高层物理入口。
偏压延续时自动缩步并在成功步调用结果采集回调；数值失败不跳过而记录。

task_recipes.description: 依据固定1D硅PN结几何、掺杂和温度，先求平衡再初始化漂移扩散，完成0→0.3 V偏压延续，输出I-V和内部场并检查接触电流连续。
task_recipes.initial_state: 全新DEVSIM进程或reset_devsim后无器件；可访问固定fixture常量，不能读取上次episode缓存。

steps.description: 创建固定1D网格、Si区域与top/bot接触并实例化器件。
设置300 K硅、寿命以及Donors/Acceptors/NetDoping节点表达式。
创建Potential变量、Poisson模型及零偏压接触，求平衡。
建立Electrons/Holes并从IntrinsicElectrons/IntrinsicHoles初始化；添加DD及接触方程并求零偏解。
逐步偏压或rampbias延续，读取各接触电子+空穴电流与节点/边场。
保存原生器件文件和指标记录，在新状态中加载并查询几何/场一致性。

assertions: 每个指定偏压的solve成功；solve(info=True)的成功标志和迭代输出结构以实际版本运行结果为准。
对每个偏压，abs(I_top+I_bot) <= 1e-10 + 1e-6*max(abs(I_top),abs(I_bot))；I为同一1D归一化的电子+空穴总电流。
非零前向工作点电流幅值随0.1→0.3 V递增，零偏不使用纯相对误差。
保存并恢复后各节点Potential绝对误差<=1e-12 V；载流子rtol<=1e-10（基于原生格式实际精度再锁定）。
task_recipes.tolerance_status: 原定容差保持不变。默认double导致零偏接触电流连续性失败，保存失败证据；按官方例程启用extended_solver/model/equation后465节点固定PN扫描通过。
task_recipes.numerical_boundary: solve的绝对/相对更新准则不是残差；本次独立物理检查是接触电流连续，不声称已经验证所有残差。

task_recipes.description: 给定一维介质电容和错误介电常数配置，通过字段和方程查询定位其电荷不满足解析目标，修复Permittivity并重求解，使电势、场、两端电荷和单位面积电容满足解析解。
task_recipes.initial_state: 固定1D介质、top=1 V、bot=0 V；Permittivity误设为39*8.85e-14 F/cm。网格/边界/目标均已知，修复不能修改目标。

steps.description: 创建两端接触的均匀一维介质结构；实例化Potential及ElectricField/DField与其导数。
设置错误介电常数，定义PotentialEquation及两个固定电势边界后求解。
读取参数、实际方程及接触电荷，证明错误设置违反不可修改的解析电荷目标。
只修复Permittivity为目标材料值，重求解并读取电势/场/电荷。

assertions: 错误配置下电荷目标断言必须失败，不能仅检查程序是否正常退出。

init_ref_tools.name: BilinearForm
init_ref_tools.description: A bilinear form for finite element assembly.  Bilinear forms are defined using functions that takes three arguments: trial function ``u``, test function ``v``, and a dictionary of additional parameters ``w``.  >>> from skfem import BilinearForm, Basis, MeshTri, ElementTriP1 >>> form = BilinearForm(lambda u, v, _: u * v) >>> form.assemble(Basis(MeshTri(), ElementTriP1())).toarray() array([[0.08333333, 0.04166667, 0.04166667, 0. ], [0.04166667, 0.16666667, 0.08333333, 0.04166667], [0.04166667, 0.08333333, 0.16666667, 0.04166667], [0. , 0.04166667, 0.04166667, 0.08333333]])  Alternatively, you can use :class:`~skfem.assembly.BilinearForm` as a decorator:  >>> @BilinearForm ... def form(u, v, _): ... return u * v  Inside the form definition, ``u`` and ``v`` are arrays containing the basis function values at quadrature points. They also contain the values of the derivatives as attributes:  >>> @BilinearForm ... def form(u, v, _): ... # u.grad[0] is first derivative with respect to x, and so on ... return u.grad[0] * v.grad[0] + u.grad[1] * v.grad[1] # laplacian  We suggest you to use helper functions from :mod:`skfem.helpers` to make the forms more readable:  >>> from skfem.helpers import dot, grad >>> @BilinearForm ... def form(u, v, w): ... return dot(grad(u), grad(v))

init_ref_tools.name: condense
init_ref_tools.description: Eliminate degrees-of-freedom from a linear system.  The user should provide the linear system ``A`` and ``b`` and either the set of DOFs to eliminate (``D``) or the set of DOFs to keep (``I``). Optionally, nonzero values for the eliminated DOFs can be supplied via ``x``.  .. note::  Supports also generalized eigenvalue problems where ``b`` is a matrix.  Example -------  Suppose that the solution vector :math:`x` can be split as  .. math::  x = \begin{bmatrix} x_I\\ x_D \end{bmatrix}  where :math:`x_D` are known and :math:`x_I` are unknown. This allows splitting the linear system as  .. math::  \begin{bmatrix} A_{II} & A_{ID}\\ A_{DI} & A_{DD} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} x_I\\ x_D \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} b_I\\ b_D \end{bmatrix}  which leads to the condensed system  .. math::  A_{II} x_I = b_I - A_{ID} x_D.  As an example, let us assemble the matrix :math:`A` and the vector :math:`b` corresponding to the Poisson equation :math:`-\Delta u = 1`.  .. doctest::  >>> import skfem as fem >>> from skfem.models.poisson import laplace, unit_load >>> m = fem.MeshTri().refined(2) >>> basis = fem.CellBasis(m, fem.ElementTriP1()) >>> A = laplace.assemble(basis) >>> b = unit_load.assemble(basis)  The condensed system is obtained with :func:`skfem.utils.condense`. Below we provide the DOFs to eliminate via the keyword argument ``D``.  .. doctest::  >>> AII, bI, xI, I = fem.condense(A, b, D=m.boundary_nodes()) >>> AII.toarray() array([[ 4., 0., 0., 0., -1., -1., -1., -1., 0.], [ 0., 4., 0., 0., -1., 0., -1., 0., 0.], [ 0., 0., 4., 0., 0., -1., 0., -1., 0.], [ 0., 0., 0., 4., -1., -1., 0., 0., 0.], [-1., -1., 0., -1., 4., 0., 0., 0., 0.], [-1., 0., -1., -1., 0., 4., 0., 0., 0.], [-1., -1., 0., 0., 0., 0., 4., 0., -1.], [-1., 0., -1., 0., 0., 0., 0., 4., -1.], [ 0., 0., 0., 0., 0., 0., -1., -1., 4.]]) >>> bI array([0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625])  By default, the eliminated DOFs are set to zero. Different values can be provided through the keyword argument ``x``; see :ref:`ex14`.

x.description: The values of the condensed degrees-of-freedom. If not given, assumed to be zero.

D.description: The set of degree-of-freedom indices to dismiss.

basic_info.name: meshio
basic_info.description: meshio 是面向多种网格格式的 Python 读写和转换库，使用统一的节点、单元块、点数据、单元数据及集合表示，支持 Gmsh、VTK、VTU、XDMF 等文件及时间序列数据交换。它可连接网格生成和数值分析流程，本身不生成网格，也不求解半导体物理方程。

basic_info.name: scikit-fem
basic_info.description: scikit-fem 是轻量有限元组装和求解库，提供网格、有限元基、双线性/线性形式、积分、边界条件、组装、线性系统求解和后处理接口，可接收 meshio 或 Gmsh 网格并构建可验证的 PDE 示例。

Each probe intercepts a connection and exposes forward and backward traveling wave ports. For a probe named "X" at instance port "inst,port", two new circuit ports are created: "X_fwd" and "X_bwd". ValueError: If netlist or models are invalid. KeyError: If required models are missing.  Example: ```python # Define component models def waveguide(length=10.0, neff=2.4, wl=1.55): phase = 2 * np.pi * neff * length / wl return {("in", "out"): np.exp(1j * phase)}  # Create netlist netlist = { "instances": { "wg1": {"component": "waveguide", "settings": {"length": 20.0}} }, "connections": {}, "ports": {"in": "wg1,in", "out": "wg1,out"}, }  # Create circuit models = {"waveguide": waveguide} circuit_func, info = circuit(netlist, models)  # Evaluate circuit s_matrix = circuit_func(wl=1.55) ```

init_ref_tools.ori_description: Grating coupler model for fiber-chip coupling.  ```{svgbob} out0 o2 / / / / / / / / fiber / / / / _ _ _ o1 _| |_| |_| |__ in0 ```  Args: wl: Operating wavelength in micrometers. Can be a scalar or array for spectral analysis. Defaults to 1.55 μm. wl0: Center wavelength in micrometers where peak transmission occurs. This is the design wavelength of the grating. Defaults to 1.55 μm. loss: Insertion loss in dB at the center wavelength. Includes coupling efficiency losses, scattering, and mode mismatch. Defaults to 0.0 dB. reflection: Reflection coefficient from the waveguide side (chip interface). Represents reflections back into the waveguide from grating discontinuities. Range: 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.0. reflection_fiber: Reflection coefficient from the fiber side (top interface). Represents reflections back toward the fiber from the grating surface. Range: 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.0. bandwidth: 3dB bandwidth in micrometers. Determines the spectral width of the Gaussian transmission profile. Typical values: 20-50 nm. Defaults to 40e-3 μm (40 nm).  Returns: The grating coupler s-matrix  Examples: Basic grating coupler:  ```python import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np import sax  sax.set_port_naming_strategy("optical")  wl = np.linspace(1.5, 1.6, 101) s = sax.models.grating_coupler( wl=wl, loss=3.0, bandwidth=0.035, ) plt.figure() plt.plot(wl, np.abs(s[("o1", "o2")]) ** 2, label="Transmission") plt.xlabel("Wavelength (μm)") plt.ylabel("Power") plt.legend() ```  Note: The transmission power profile follows a Gaussian shape: P(λ) = P₀ * exp(-((λ-λ₀)/σ)²)  The amplitude transmission is: A(λ) = A₀ * exp(-((λ-λ₀)/σ)²/2)  Where σ = bandwidth / (2*√(2*ln(2))) converts FWHM to Gaussian width.  This model assumes:  - Gaussian spectral response (typical for uniform gratings) - Wavelength-independent loss coefficient - Linear polarization (TE or TM) - Single-mode fiber coupling - No higher-order diffraction effects

task_recipes.description: 定位固定全通环中忘记将0.1dB/um转换为1000dB/cm的模型输入错误：实际求解错误设置并由固定解析oracle拒绝，修复loss_dB_cm后重新求解，输出通过同一oracle的复数频谱。

steps.description: 构造耦合器与闭环波导，保留物理损耗0.1dB/um作为固定目标；错误输入将同一个数0.1直接传给loss_dB_cm。
使用支持反馈的filipsson_gunnar后端编译，实际调用返回模型分别计算loss_dB_cm=0.1的错误响应和修复为1000.0后的响应。
提取错误与修复后的复数S参数，用完全相同的独立all-pass解析式及容差验收：错误响应必须触发AssertionError，修复响应必须通过；保存两条谱线和oracle。
steps.runtime_operation: NumPy解析式(t-a exp(i phi))/(1-t a exp(i phi))与NPZ输出

assertions: 实际调用SAX得到loss_dB_cm=0.1的错误模型响应，必须被同一个固定解析oracle拒绝，捕获AssertionError
修复为loss_dB_cm=1000.0后实际重算通过同一oracle；不改变oracle来迎合模型输出

fixture.oracle: 显式单位换算+闭式all-pass复数响应
